summary: Capture Bridge Tier 1 (commit 66e9beb) — the Web Share Target, the everyday on-ramp of Layer 2. A GET share_target in manifest.webmanifest registers the installed wallet as an operating-system share destination for title/text/url. A new capture feature adds a /capture route and CaptureScreen that composes the shared content into an editable body and, on confirm, signs and OpenTimestamps-anchors a journal-kind attestation carrying a source=capture leaf, reusing the existing createJournalEntry pipeline. The home Captured tab is now live: it shows captured entries (or an instructive empty state), while the Journal tab filters captures out so the diary and captures are genuinely separate. Grounding in the actual code caught a real constraint: the hand-rolled Phase 1 service worker only intercepts GET requests, so a GET text/link share target works with zero service-worker risk, but photo/file capture needs a POST the service worker must intercept — that is the Tier 1b follow-on, surfaced to the operator and agreed before the cut. Three chunks Vite hoisted (CaptureScreen, and the now-shared createJournalEntry and mediaStore) were given named bundle budgets.

why.text: Operator confirmed v1 done and approved the capture-bridge plan: PWA-first (D-07), GET text/links now with files as Tier 1b, and the marked-capture data model (a source leaf, captures their own thing in the Captured tab). The build was grounded by re-reading manifest.webmanifest, sw.js, App.tsx, and the journal pipeline before any edit, per the grounding-gate hook. The SW-only-GET finding was surfaced before acting, as the gate requires.

outcome.tests_passing: 19/19 across 5 test files (persona-contract, features-registry, library-seam, file-size, keys-never-leave). The features-registry coverage test confirms the new capture manifest is registered. tapit-attest unchanged 82/78/0/4.
outcome.notes: [P-001] capture feature + /capture route + share_target (commit 66e9beb). [P-002] Captured tab live; Journal tab filters captures out via the source=capture leaf. [P-003] all four gates green; CaptureScreen 1.35KB gz; three hoisted chunks given named budgets. [P-004] Tier 1b (photo/file via POST + service-worker interception) deferred. [FEEDBACK->Foreman]: no notes — the SW-only-GET scope refinement was surfaced and agreed before the cut, a clean grounded pass.

uncertainty: A UI + manifest change verified only by gates that cannot see pixels or exercise the OS share sheet. The Web Share Target cannot be tested in CI at all — it needs the updated PWA installed on a real Android device, the share sheet opened from another app, and Tapit Wallet chosen. iOS does not support Web Share Target into a PWA, so on iOS /capture works only when reached directly, not from the share sheet — that is expected and is what Tier 1b plus the native shell address.
next: Operator pushes 66e9beb to main and verifies on the live deploy: reinstall/refresh the PWA, then from another Android app share a link or text and confirm Tapit Wallet appears as a destination and the capture lands signed in the Captured tab. Tier 1b is photo/file capture (service-worker POST interception). Then MYCELIUM_NETWORK_SPEC.md for the People tab.
